items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Phyllis Butts, that was the instructor there, and she accepted me.

ctx.x: On top. I didn't want them to say, "Is she still here?" I didn't want that. So, when my mother passed, on January the 17th, 1954, I went to -- started to school the next day, nursing school. I went to the YWCA nursing school on 137th Street, and Phyllis Butts, that was the instructor there, and she accepted me. And I started to school, nursing school. And I was a little old there, you know, but fortunately I left that state board with a marvelous rating.
